# See Job Run

> See Job Run is construction management software for independent general contractors and small crews. Jobs, scheduling, tasks, time tracking, job-site photos, documents, budgets, invoices and change orders are in one app that works in the web browser on any phone, tablet or computer, in English and Spanish. Plans start at $69/month with every feature included, and every plan starts with a 60-day free trial (no credit card).

## Who it's for
Small and independent general contractors, remodelers and custom-home builders who run their own crews and subcontractors.

## What it does
- **Jobs & leads**: track every lead and job, with its contacts, documents, photos and materials.
- **Scheduling**: drag-and-drop job schedule, master calendar, appointments and daily production reports.
- **Tasks**: assign tasks to employees and subcontractors and see them get done.
- **Time tracking**: start/stop timers on each job and time logged per job.
- **Money records**: estimates, budgets (with Excel export), invoices and change orders. See Job Run records job payments; it does not process them.
- **E-sign**: clients sign quotes and change orders online.
- **People**: employees, free subcontractor and client access, in-app chat, push and email alerts.
- **English & Spanish**: each user picks English or Spanish for the whole app.

## Pricing (USD, per month)
- **Starter — $69**: 1–3 employees.
- **Team — $99**: up to 5 employees.
- **Crew — $129**: up to 10 employees.
- **+$15 per employee** over 10.
- Every feature on every plan. Subcontractors and clients are always free.
- 60-day free trial, no credit card.

## Platforms
The web browser on any phone, tablet or computer. There is no App Store or Google Play app; on a phone you add it from the browser to the home screen.
